text:
june: noticed several EU2 GPU nodes failing to finish bootstrap after the egress lockdown. node logs show kms:Decrypt AccessDenied + grant expired.

vikram: Which grant/key? Any stack trace?

june: From node agent: 
```
2026-03-25T11:01:12Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed AccessDenied: not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:111111111111:key/8a7b-cdef
Reason: grant not found or expired while waiting for audit-shipper ack
```

ops-sre: Context: firewall change blocked direct public KMS/S3 endpoints and forced privatelink. Audit-shipper still uses NAT so boot path relies on shipper ack & short-lived KMS grant; nodes waiting, grant TTL lapses.

vikram: Two immediate options: (A) short NAT allowlist for provisioning subnets -> fastest to unblock but increases egress cost and attack surface; (B) create short-lived delegated KMS grants from control-plane tied to bootstrap token -> safer network-side but needs sequencing work.

june: Compliance/ops: any constraints on temporary allowlist?

compliance-bot: Policy: temporary egress exceptions permitted up to 30 minutes if flow-logs enabled and change is logged. Anything >30m requires change owner sign-off.

ops-sre: Suggestion: push a 20m allowlist scoped to audit-shipper ENIs + KMS FQDNs, enable VPC flow logs to locked bucket, and simultaneously implement grant creation in control-plane as fallback. If canaries pass in 10m, retire NAT.

vikram: I can implement grant flow quickly: control-plane will call aws:kms:create-grant when emitting bootstrap token, store grantId alongside token, and retire after 10m. Sample: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/gpu-keystore --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/gpu-node-role --operations Decrypt --name boot-grant-temp
```
This removes need to touch firewall long-term.

june: Cost note: current retry churn ~0.8 GPU-hours in last 30m. NAT open will incur extra S3 egress for audit shipper. Keep window minimal.

ops-sre: I'll create allowlist rule: FW-1930 (egress allow: audit-shipper ENIs) and FW-1931 (egress allow: kms.svc.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com) TTL 20m, flow-logs ON. Monitoring: revert if join_fail_rate >5% or unexpected S3 egress >$200 in 20m.

compliance-bot: Change logged: CHG-8812. Ensure grant creation/retire events go to CloudTrail and include grantId in audit record.

vikram: Will add unit tests and a staged rollout: staging first, then canary tag provisioning:canary=true for initial 10 nodes. Also adding preflight check that verifies KMS decrypt reachable before marking pool healthy.

june: Okay, apply FW rules and post rule IDs. Keep me posted on join metrics.

ops-sre: Applied FW-1930/1931. Canaries started. Current join success: 9/10 joined within decrypt timeout. Will monitor and then retire NAT while control-plane grant work lands.

vikram: PR opened for create-grant flow (link omitted). ETA deploy 75m. After deploy we'll remove NAT exception and rely on grant.

june: Thanks all — filing incident INC-1050 for follow-up and postmortem. Add action item: automate grant lifecycle + verify privatelink cross-account key policies in runbook.
